name: White catalogue cut-out
description: The product centred on plain white with even light and a faint contact shadow, the shot marketplaces ask for. Use it for listings and specification sheets.
prompt: Catalogue product photograph: the product in image 1, unchanged in shape, colour and label, centred on a plain pure-white background, shot straight on at {{ angle }}. Even soft light from both sides, no colour cast, a faint contact shadow directly under the product only, every edge clean and in focus, the label completely readable. Nothing else in frame. No text, no watermark, no reflections.
negative_prompt: grey background, gradient, harsh shadow, props, warped label, text, watermark
author: kilnry
